title: iamajmeena/neonclipping
why_read: A practical open-source tool for automatically generating short captioned video clips from longer content using local LLMs, useful for content creators.
analysis: This tool automates a common but tedious workflow: extracting short vertical clips with captions from longer videos, using local processing rather than cloud services. The audio-first and local-LLM approach suggests attention to privacy and cost, which is appealing compared to many paid SaaS clipping tools. It's a solid applied engineering tool rather than a research contribution, useful mainly to content creators and marketers rather than engineers in general.
